entities.name: Yūsaku Kuwazuru
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yusaku Kuwazuru  is a Japanese rugby union coach and former player. He played for Japanese club Coca-Cola Red Sparks in the Top League. He was part of Japan's sevens squad that played at the 2014 Hong Kong Sevens and won the World Series Qualifier for the 2014–15 Sevens World Series.
